description.p: SKJ Files is a file manager that starts almost instantly and stays out of your way. It has tabs, a dual pane, a column view, a command palette, real thumbnails, colour tags, batch rename, checksums and archive handling.

SKJ Files to menedżer plików, który uruchamia się niemal natychmiast i nie wchodzi w drogę. Ma karty, dwa panele, widok kolumnowy, paletę poleceń, prawdziwe miniatury, kolorowe etykiety, zmianę nazw wsadowo, sumy kontrolne i obsługę archiwów.

ul.li: Tabs that come back when you reopen it, and a dual pane
Details and grid views with image, video and PDF thumbnails
Command palette, column view, customisable toolbar and shortcuts
Copy and move with conflict handling, progress, speed and time left
CRC32, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 and BLAKE3 checksums
ZIP and tar compression and extraction
English and Polish, switching instantly without a restart

description.p: First stable release. Adds a duplicate finder, a disk usage view, your own right-click commands, an update check, row density, a custom accent colour, SKJ Files' own title bar, a translucent window on Windows 11, and a crash log.
Command palette, column view, tab reordering, the Windows shell context menu, network locations, custom shortcuts and toolbar, and a Polish translation.
